scenarios.name: smt-cross-check
scenarios.question: Two bounded integer-linear questions over {x,y} in QF_LIA, each answered independently by z3 and cvc5: (A1) is the constraint set contradictory, (A2) does the linear system have a satisfying assignment and what is it?

z3.probed: Z3 version 5.4.0 - 64 bit - build hashcode d6c9b4fbb31cb76e35cc325dd7e64b7c26c7d70f

inputs.text:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const y Int)
(assert (>= x 0))
(assert (>= y 0))
(assert (<= (+ x y) 2))
(assert (>= x 3))
(check-sat)
inputs.intended_question: Does there exist an integer pair (x,y) with x>=0, y>=0, x+y<=2 and x>=3? (bounded integer-linear contradiction)

inputs.text:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const y Int)
(assert (>= x 0))
(assert (<= x 10))
(assert (>= y 0))
(assert (<= y 10))
(assert (= x 2))
(assert (= (+ x y) 5))
(check-sat)
(get-value (x y))
inputs.intended_question: Within 0<=x,y<=10, does x=2 and x+y=5 have a satisfying assignment, and what is it? (unique model x=2, y=3 so both solvers report the same model)

scenarios.comparison_rule: AGREE_UNSAT when both solvers emit unsat; AGREE_SAT when both emit sat (A2 additionally compares get-value models, which are unique by construction). Any verdict mismatch, unknown, timeout or parse failure is fail-closed: TOOL_DISAGREEMENT / UNKNOWN / PARSE_ERROR, never a silent pass.

scenarios.name: highs-lp
scenarios.question: Maximize 3x+2y over 0<=x,y<=10 with x+y<=4 and x-y>=1 (feasible variant; unique optimum x=4,y=0, objective 12), and the same box with x+y<=1 and x-y>=3 (infeasible variant). Does the pinned typed HiGHS operation return kOptimal/kInfeasible accordingly?

model_contract.variables_shape: same length as objective; each {lower, upper} with null or finite number, lower<=upper
